name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: A row of cards the reader swipes through: today's updates, featured answers, the games to play next. On a phone it is the shape people already know from every feed; on a wide screen it shows several cards at once and two buttons page through the rest.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/carousel

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/carousel.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/carousel';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/carousel

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
